$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFLN (AIP France, chart dated 2026-08-06): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.

Preferred QFU 326°: due to IFR procedures.
Low height traffic circuits: West of AD only within the context of training flights with an instructor on board.
MNM 500 ft AAL.
Noise sensitive AD - Avoid overflying the surrounding built-up areas.
Engine tests before Take-off on T1, T3 and T5.
Outside ATS SKED, half turn prohibited on unpaved RWY 15/33.
Flight request with assistance: MON - FRI: RFFS SKED, only at rffs.lfln@aeroportsaintyan.fr are recommended for VFR flights.
With IFR traffic, ACFT and HEL MTO MNM (CTR): VIS secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0).
STAP and PCL outside ATS SKED.
PCL on photoelectric cell.
Lighting may be turned off by 7 alternate strokes within less than 5 seconds.
STAP: available data (FR only): wind, VIS, cloud base, T, DP, QNH, QFE.
If PAPI 15 out of service under PCL use, landing is prohibited.
Radiocommunication failure: As far as possible, use a cellphone to contact TWR.
CTR part 2 may be downgraded to class G for the benefit of special activities according to modalities described by the protocol between users and ST YAN ACC.
Actual activity on SAINT YAN APP and CLERMONT INFO.
